author: ojiudezue
title: Boot-settle collapses different stuck-sensor kinds, and the stuck latch is set even when NM dropped the page
summary: Live validation of v5.108.30 found the first act-mode chatter page (Garage B ratgdo motion) never reached notification_log. NM boot-settle keys on (coordinator, hazard_type) for 60 s after setup, and every stuck kind shares one hazard type, so the chatter page was swallowed by a dutycycle page sent 9 s earlier. fire_stuck_signal still set its per-day latch, so chatter stays silent until tomorrow.
why: Two rules collided: boot-settle was written to quiet boot storms of the SAME hazard, but stuck kinds are distinct faults under one hazard type; and the latch had no discharge for a suppressed send (the suppression-needs-discharge rule). The validator's DB-row check is what caught it: the title was right, the row was missing.
implications: Any coordinator that multiplexes distinct faults under one hazard_type loses all but the first at boot. Fix in flight on fix/nm-boot-settle-stuck-kinds (builder enumerates async_notify callers before choosing key scope); ships with v5.108.33. Also: README S3a-2's observable (excluded_sensors) never showed chatter exclusions; acceptance signals must be checked against the producer before they are written.
alternatives_considered: Add location to the boot-settle key house-wide (simplest, may raise boot noise for per-camera perimeter pages); scope to the stuck-signal coordinator; or keep the key and only stop the latch on a dropped send (still loses the page today). Builder picks after the caller enumeration.
revisit_trigger: If the house-wide key change raises boot-time page counts, scope it back to stuck_signal.
